execution_profile.scope: Explicit new common discrete-event condition: same pace10 absolute planned token grid, target1RTF not guaranteed; physical10sim-ms/10iterations, single inflight and20sim-ms native credit, broadcast-v1 raster and default Gateway executor retained. Only health/mask300ms receipt deadlines (including external R Observer peer heartbeat) use actual R ROS simulation time; original monotonic receipt logs remain separately named. Source-age .4sim odom/.55sim correction and future rules, Peer odom receipt .2wall, Gateway process status .3wall, policy/model/source rates/QoS/RF remain unchanged. Independent2wall safeguards monitor active local R clock progress and independent TimeController administrative liveness/failure; coordinator bounds physical inflight ACK in every mode from each actual issue, and activates RUN clock/native ACK progress protection once on the first same-session status observing any actual R Guard armed. The separate armed-since monotonic baseline never renews on repeated status/ARM/HOLD-to-RUN, and actual clock/native progress stamps are never fabricated from bootstrap tokens; each deadline uses the later of armed-since and actual progress. Unarmed preflight retains the original startup180wall bound and per-physicalRPC2wall protection. Explicit preflight HOLD/STOP before ARM does not grant permission or permanently revoke future ARM; an armed HOLD without authority exit faults, and verified authority-exit STOP_OBSERVE (including its following HOLD before expected-shutdown is latched) revokes permission and uses actual UUID cancel/zero/PAUSE without synthesizing business outcomes. Authority-stopped stop observation has no business permission; physical inflight still has a2wall bound. All callback/timing/achieved workload/availability/trajectories can differ; rebuild matched A0/A1/B/C baselines. No wall-real-time deployment or physics/stop guarantee follows from this profile; frozen policy and physical evidence remain required. Post-stop Gateway evidence finalization is separate from active permissions: only after actual final stop/authority exit/seal and same-process resource-closure proof, the original20wall grace may use a fixed total60wall including reserved TERM/KILL, clipped to existing cleanup/outer/host absolute deadlines. No saved marker substitutes for normal process exit; original stop12 and all active safety thresholds remain unchanged.
